assumptions.fees: Illustrative paper fee, not a broker quote
assumptions.fills: Observed ask plus slippage in; bid minus slippage out; not a guaranteed limit fill
assumptions.volume_ratio: Latest completed candle divided by recent candle median, not time-of-day historical RVOL
assumptions.weekly_capacity: Reserve full remaining value of all open options; weekly allowance never expands above Monday's 10 percent budget
